craft_notes: Sthāyin: sight-joy. Dropped L3 'on' (filler repaired). Close: remembering. Rejected: 'realization' — killed.

lines: Face to face he sees the sure, by Rudra's powers drawn —
sky-standing in two watches' time, remembering.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sākṣātpaśyatyasaṃdigdhamākṛṣṭaṃ rudraśaktibhiḥ praharadvayamātreṇa vyomastho jāyate smaran |

reads_against.argmap: Face to face sees the undoubted drawn by Rudra-powers; by mere two watches sky-standing, remembering.
c1_essence: Undoubted seen, Rudra-drawn; two watches, sky-standing.
